benefits.text:
BBIA Last Auto Gel Eyeliner is a vegan twist-up gel eyeliner that helps create defined, smooth lines that are easy to work with for many eye makeup looks. The gel texture glides smoothly over the eye area and delivers good color payoff without feeling dry or rough, suited to lining the lid, accenting the outer corner, adding depth, or using the light shades to highlight the under-eye/inner corner depending on the shade. The waterproof and smudge-proof formula helps the line adhere better and helps minimize smudging and wearing off from water, sweat or excess oil, especially suited to those who need neat, sharp and stable eyeliner throughout the day.
1. Soft, smooth gel texture that is easy to apply, helping create a defined line without tugging on the eye area.
2. Water-resistant formula that helps minimize smudging and wearing off, helping keep the line clean and neat for longer.
3. Compact auto pencil design, easy to use and convenient to carry; twist up about 1–2mm of the core each time to help minimize breakage.

With a varied shade range from black, brown and rose brown to beige/light shades for the under-eye, BBIA Last Auto Gel Eyeliner is not just a basic eyeliner but can also be used flexibly for many different eye makeup needs. It suits beginners because the line is easy to control, and also suits everyday makeup wearers who need a soft, compact gel liner with clear color payoff and better adherence on oil-prone eyelids.

safety.text:
For external use on the eye area only; avoid direct contact of the product with the eyes.
If it gets into the eyes, rinse thoroughly with water immediately and stop use if any unusual signs appear.

howToUse.text:
Before lining, apply a thin layer of powder to remove oil.
Twist up about 1-2mm of the gel eyeliner each time you use it.
Fill in the gaps between the lashes, then connect them to create a complete line.
Close the cap tightly after use to keep the product from drying out.

positioning.text: Soft, smooth gel eyeliner pencil that helps create defined lines, is easy to work with and suits many eye makeup looks.

sellingPoints.text: Soft, smooth gel formula for smooth lines; long-lasting color and helps resist water; compact design with a sharpener included.

texture.text: Twist-up gel eyeliner pencil, soft and smooth, glides easily.

claimDisclaimers.text: The product is water-resistant. Do not say it is absolutely waterproof, 100% smudge-proof, or that the color stays fully intact in all conditions.
